newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Monte Paschi aims for 1997 operating rise.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Monte Paschi aims for 1997 operating rise.

text.p: Italian bank Monte Paschi di Siena is aiming for a five percent rise in its operating result in 1997 and a six percent increase in return on equity, sources close to the bank said on Thursday.
The sources, who spoke after the board met to approve the 1997 budget, said loans were expected to rise 4.5 percent.

The bank, which is controlled by local authorities, saw a 40 percent rise in its net profit in 1996 to 210 billion lire from 151 billion lire in 1995, according to preliminary results published earlier this month.

1996 operating result remained unchanged at 1.02 trillion lire. Direct client deposits rose six percent to 44.58 trillion lire, while indirect deposits rose 6.5 percent to 62 trillion. Client loans rose 1.7 percent to 39.53 trillion lire.
